title: Mangrove Loss Fell 45% Before the Destruction Stopped
hook: Mangrove destruction is not accelerating: annual loss fell 45%.
closing: Slowing destruction proves protection can work, but coastlines still need the remaining forests.
question: Can protection finish the job?

segments.say: Mangrove forests lost 3.6 million hectares, shrinking a natural barrier that protects coastlines.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares, the largest regional decline shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102 thousand hectares, showing destruction can be reduced before it stops.
